g.text: Arithmetic-only instruction: fixed versus freshly generated A

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526177

g.text: Each run: 50 questions × 10 trials × 3 checkpoints = 1,500 evaluations. Same corrections and B instruction.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526177

g.text: Within each checkpoint, all windows use the same complete-50 responses. Fixed A: 468/500/500; fresh A: 464/500/500.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526177

g.text: Shading: pointwise 95% question-bootstrap intervals. Matching y-axis scales within each row; equal question weights.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526177

g.text: The full window averages the two halves. Scores are entropy-ablation proxies; no answer-correctness evaluation.
